Ant Foraging Simulation

Description:
An agent-based stochastic simulation investigating how localized interactions and pheromone gradient fields lead to optimal foraging routes and resource gathering efficiency.
Python Stochastic Modeling Differential Equations Simulation


Preview Methodology & Equations


Mathematical Formulation
Pheromone trail concentration \(P(x, y, t)\) across the continuous spatial domain is modeled incorporating both diffusion and exponential decay:
\[\frac{\partial P}{\partial t} = D \nabla^2 P - \gamma P + S(x, y, t)\]
Where: * \(D\) is the spatial diffusion coefficient. * \(\gamma\) is the natural evaporation rate constant. * \(S(x, y, t)\) represents pheromone deposition by returning foragers.

Propofol Clearance & Pharmacokinetics

Description:
A three-compartment pharmacokinetic model evaluating the distribution, clearance kinetics, and dynamic equilibrium of propofol in central and peripheral tissue volumes during clinical infusion protocols.
Python R Pharmacokinetics ODEs Numerical Integration


Preview Compartment Model


System of Differential Equations
The rate of change of drug mass in the central compartment \(x_1(t)\) and peripheral compartments \(x_2(t), x_3(t)\) is expressed by:
\[\frac{dx_1}{dt} = I(t) - (k_{10} + k_{12} + k_{13})x_1 + k_{21}x_2 + k_{31}x_3\]
\[\frac{dx_2}{dt} = k_{12}x_1 - k_{21}x_2\]
\[\frac{dx_3}{dt} = k_{13}x_1 - k_{31}x_3\]
Where \(I(t)\) is the input infusion rate and \(k_{ij}\) are inter-compartmental micro-rate transfer constants.
